:= by
  have assoc : ∀ p q r : M2, mul (mul p q) r = mul p (mul q r) := by
    intro p q r
    cases p; cases q; cases r
    simp only [mul, Int.add_mul, Int.mul_add, Int.mul_assoc, M2.mk.injEq]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> omega
  have mul_one : ∀ p : M2, mul p one = p := by
    intro p
    cases p
    simp [mul, one]
  have pow_add : ∀ a b, pow x (a + b) = mul (pow x a) (pow x b) := by
    intro a b
    induction b with
    | zero =>
      show pow x a = mul (pow x a) one
      rw [mul_one]
    | succ b ih =>
      show mul (pow x (a + b)) x = mul (pow x a) (mul (pow x b) x)
      rw [ih, assoc]
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.mul_zero]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    show pow x (m * n + m) = mul (pow (pow x m) n) (pow x m)
    rw [pow_add, ih]

:= by
  have hU : det U = -3 := by decide
  have h2 : ((u (n+2):Int) * (3 * (u n:Int)) - 3 * (u (n+1):Int) * (u (n+1):Int))
      = (-3)^n * (-3) := by
    rw [← Int.pow_succ, ← hU, ← det_pow, U_pow]; rfl
  rw [Int.mul_left_comm (u (n+2):Int) 3 (u n:Int), Int.mul_assoc 3] at h2
  have hb : ((u (n+1):Int))^2 = (u (n+1):Int) * (u (n+1):Int) := by
    rw [show (2:Nat) = 0+1+1 from rfl, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_zero, Int.one_mul]
  rw [hb]
  generalize ((u (n+2):Int) * (u n:Int)) = X at h2 ⊢
  generalize ((u (n+1):Int) * (u (n+1):Int)) = Y at h2 ⊢
  generalize ((-3:Int)^n) = P at h2 ⊢
  omega

:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.mul_zero]
    have h0 : u 0 = 0 := rfl
    rw [h0]
    exact Nat.dvd_zero _
  | succ k ih =>
    cases m with
    | zero =>
      rw [Nat.zero_mul]
      exact Nat.dvd_refl _
    | succ m' =>
      have hm : ∀ a b : Nat, a * (b+1) = a*b + a := fun a b => Nat.mul_succ a b
      have e := u_add ((m'+1)*k) m'
      rw [Nat.add_assoc] at e
      rw [hm (m'+1) k, e]
      apply Nat.dvd_add
      · exact Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _
      · exact Nat.dvd_trans ih
          (Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_mul_left (u ((m'+1)*k)) 3)
            (Nat.dvd_mul_right (3 * u ((m'+1)*k)) (u m')))

:= by
  have add : ∀ m n, u (n + m + 1) = u (n+1) * u (m+1) + 3 * u n * u m := by
    have h : ∀ m, (∀ n, u (n + m + 1) = u (n+1) * u (m+1) + 3 * u n * u m) ∧
        (∀ n, u (n + (m+1) + 1) = u (n+1) * u (m+1+1) + 3 * u n * u (m+1)) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        constructor
        · intro n
          rw [show u (0+1) = 1 from rfl, show u 0 = 0 from rfl,
            show n + 0 + 1 = n + 1 by omega]
          omega
        · intro n
          have := u_succ_succ n
          rw [show u (0+1+1) = 5 from rfl, show u (0+1) = 1 from rfl,
            show n + (0+1) + 1 = n + 2 by omega, this]
          omega
      | succ m ih =>
        refine ⟨ih.2, ?_⟩
        intro n
        have e1 := ih.1 n
        have e2 := ih.2 n
        have h1 : u (n + (m+1+1) + 1) = 5 * u (n + (m+1) + 1) + 3 * u (n + m + 1) := by
          have := u_succ_succ (n + m + 1)
          rw [show n + m + 1 + 2 = n + (m+1+1) + 1 by omega,
            show n + m + 1 + 1 = n + (m+1) + 1 by omega] at this
          exact this
        have h2 : u (m+1+1+1) = 5 * u (m+1+1) + 3 * u (m+1) := u_succ_succ (m+1)
        have h3 : u (m+1+1) = 5 * u (m+1) + 3 * u m := u_succ_succ m
        rw [h1, h2, e2, e1, h3]
        simp only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm] <;> omega
    intro m n
    exact (h m).1 n
  intro k
  cases m with
  | zero => rw [Nat.zero_mul]; exact Nat.dvd_refl _
  | succ m' =>
    induction k with
    | zero => rw [Nat.mul_zero]; exact Nat.dvd_zero _
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [show (m'+1)*(k+1) = (m'+1)*k + m' + 1 by rw [Nat.mul_succ]; omega, add m']
      exact Nat.dvd_add (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)
        (Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_trans ih (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ 3)) (Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _))

:= by
  have sq : ∀ x : Int, x^2 = x*x := fun x => by
    first
      | rw [Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_zero, Int.one_mul]
      | simp [Int.pow_succ]
  have key : ∀ a b c : Int, c = 5*b+3*a →
      c*c - (5*c+3*b)*b = (b*b - c*a)*(-3) := by
    intro a b c h2
    have e1 : c*c = 5*(c*b) + 3*(c*a) := by
      calc c*c = c*(5*b+3*a) := by rw [← h2]
        _ = 5*(c*b) + 3*(c*a) := by
          rw [Int.mul_add, Int.mul_left_comm c 5 b, Int.mul_left_comm c 3 a]
    have e2 : (5*c+3*b)*b = 5*(c*b) + 3*(b*b) := by
      rw [Int.add_mul, Int.mul_assoc, Int.mul_assoc]
    omega
  induction n with
  | zero => first | decide | rfl | simp [u]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 : (u (n+3) : Int) = 5 * u (n+2) + 3 * u (n+1) := by
      have h : u (n+3) = 5 * u (n+2) + 3 * u (n+1) := u_succ_succ (n+1)
      omega
    have h2 : (u (n+2) : Int) = 5 * u (n+1) + 3 * u n := by
      have h : u (n+2) = 5 * u (n+1) + 3 * u n := u_succ_succ n
      omega
    show (u (n+2) : Int)^2 - u (n+3) * u (n+1) = (-3)^(n+1)
    rw [sq] at ih
    rw [sq, Int.pow_succ, ← ih, h1]
    exact key _ _ _ h2
